text:
maria-support: Escalation from NovusHealth — they say a number of objects were deleted well before their 1yr custom retention. They also attached logs that show KMS errors during the window. Raising to infra + legal.
novus-cust-rep: We were on rp-1yr-2025. Objects should be retained until 2029-01-16. Deletion timestamps in our export: 2028-02-12T03:12:05Z. Please preserve and explain.
sam-platform: Can you paste workspace id, policy id, and one sample object id so we can trace? Also ticket #INC-9921.
maria-support: Workspace WH-9842, policy rp-1yr-2025, example object obj_9a8b7c. Customer export shows delete_time=2028-02-12T03:12:05Z.
kevin-sre: Checking our side — there's a short audit ingest gap around 03:00-03:40 UTC that day. HSM key alias rotation happened during maintenance. Pulling logs now.
maria-support: Customer provided a snippet from their export:
```
object_id: obj_9a8b7c
created: 2027-01-16T14:04:12Z
expected_retention_until: 2029-01-16T14:04:12Z
deletion_time: 2028-02-12T03:12:05Z
note: delete triggered by system worker
```
sam-platform: On our audit shard I see the delete event but retention_policy was null in the deletion metadata. Query:
```
SELECT object_id, deletion_time, retention_policy FROM deletion_events WHERE object_id='obj_9a8b7c';
-- result: retention_policy = NULL, deletion_time = '2028-02-12T03:12:05Z'
```
jordan-legal: Novus claims Legal Hold LH-3321 was created 2028-01-16 14:05 UTC. They provided POA. We need proof the hold was applied to the workspace at the system level.
maria-support: I checked object metadata via the API (support session):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/workspaces/WH-9842/objects/obj_9a8b7c/metadata
{
  "object_id": "obj_9a8b7c",
  "retention_policy": "default_90d",
  "legal_hold": false
}
```
kevin-sre: Preliminary hypothesis: retention_mappings_v2 migration job failed to populate mapping table for WH-9842 before the delete worker ran. Fallback was default_90d in metadata, so objects became eligible for deletion. Also observed intermittent KMS decrypt failures during alias rotation which could have affected hold verification.
deploy-bot: deploy: retention-mapper-v2 2028-02-12T02:40:12Z -> success
sam-platform: Can you run the retention backfill for that workspace to confirm scope? Command:
```
./tools/retention-backfill --workspace WH-9842 --since '2028-01-01'
```
kevin-sre: Running backfill now. Quick results: 342 objects missing mapping, approximate window 2028-02-12T02:30 → 2028-02-12T03:20. Plan: 1) pause delete workers for WH-9842, 2) backfill mapping table, 3) produce audit export for legal, 4) assess restore options for any still-restorable tombstones. ETA 90m.
maria-support: Told the customer we have a plan, asked for written authorization to attempt restores if technically possible. They replied "Please preserve everything and provide timeline."
jordan-legal: We need a full audit dump for 2028-01-15 → 2028-02-15. @kevin-sre can you export and share an access link and the exact scope?
kevin-sre: Will export audit logs and KMS decrypt events to s3://rdw-legal-exports/novus/2028-01-15_2028-02-15.tar.gz and grant read role to legal. Note: decrypt logs include entries with `key_alias=old-key` during rotation.
sam-platform: I'll open a postmortem and link this thread. Owner: sam-platform. Action items listed in ticket INC-9921.
maria-support: :eyes: I'll update Novus at 30min intervals. Customer asked for an expected timeline for backfill & audit export.
kevin-sre: Backfill started. If mapping backfill succeeds we will block further deletes and run a rolling verify. I'll post status and S3 link when ready. If restore needed we'll coordinate approvals with legal.
jordan-legal: Keep the legal hold flagged in our case system. We may request a preservation order if any irreversible deletes are found.
maria-support: closing interim update — next status update in 45m.
